events.description: Multiple players from both teams engage in mutual physical combat near the goal crease, including grappling, pushing, and punching; referees intervene to separate them.

A player in black (No. 13, Paquette) delivers a punch to a downed or off-balance opponent in yellow/white while the goalie is on the ice and unable to defend, constituting an attack on a helpless victim.

Multiple players from Pittsburgh (yellow/white) and Tampa Bay (black) engage in a multi-person scrum in front of the Pittsburgh net, involving grappling, shoving, and helmet-to-helmet contact; referees intervene to separate them.

Player #13 (Tampa Bay, black jersey) appears to deliver a punch or strike to a downed or off-balance opponent while multiple others are engaged in the fight; the victim is not actively defending himself at that moment.
Two players in Penguins jerseys are engaged in a physical altercation on the ice, with one player on top of the other; a referee intervenes and separates them.

One player is lying on the ice while another player is positioned over him in a dominant, potentially harmful manner before full referee intervention; the downed player appears unable to defend himself during this interval.

A player in a yellow and black jersey (PIT #5) is on the ice, being restrained by a referee while another player (TB #13) is on top of him in a grappling position; this constitutes mutual physical combat.

Player TB #13 is on top of the downed PIT #5, applying pressure while the referee intervenes; the downed player appears unable to defend himself, suggesting abuse of a helpless victim during the scuffle.

Two players engage in mutual physical combat: a Pittsburgh Penguins player (yellow jersey, #21) and a Tampa Bay Lightning player (black jersey, #6) grapple, fall to the ice, and continue wrestling while on the ground, with referees intervening.

After both players are on the ice, the Penguins player (#21) delivers repeated punches/strikes to the head/upper body of the downed Lightning player (#6), who is largely defenseless and unable to effectively resist, constituting abuse of a helpless victim.

Multiple players from opposing teams (Pittsburgh Penguins in yellow/black and Tampa Bay Lightning in black/white) engage in a physical altercation near the boards, with punches thrown and bodies entangled while referees intervene.

A player in black (Tampa Bay) is on the ice, seemingly downed, while another player continues to strike or press down on him amid the scrum; referees are actively trying to separate them, indicating the victim is helpless during part of the engagement.

Two players engage in a physical confrontation: the player in the yellow jersey (No. 87, Crosby) and an opponent in black grapple, with visible pushing, shoving, and body contact; the opponent’s helmet is dislodged at ~61.5s (f3), indicating forceful impact.

After the initial tussle, the opponent in black is on the ice (kneeling then prone), and the player in yellow (Crosby, No. 87) continues to apply pressure—leaning over, holding the opponent down, and making repeated contact while the opponent is unable to rise or defend himself. Referees intervene only after several seconds.
Two hockey players engage in a prolonged physical fight on the ice, involving grappling, punching, and takedowns, until referees intervene and separate them.
Two players—one in Pittsburgh Penguins yellow/black jersey (No. 73) and one in Tampa Bay Lightning black jersey—engage in a physical fight, grappling and throwing punches near the boards.

After being taken down, the Tampa Bay player is on the ice and appears helpless while the Penguins player (No. 73) continues to strike or press down on him; referees intervene to separate them, indicating the victim was unable to defend himself during part of the sequence.
